Russian Cranberry Chicken
By: Nancy
Published: Friday, February 18, 2011 - 6:07am

Ingredients




6 pieces skinless chicken (breasts and thighs work best)
1 cup Russian salad dressing
1 package dry onion soup mix
1 can whole cranberry sauce

Preparation

1 Place chicken in 9x13 oven safe casserole dish. 2 Combine all other ingredients. 3 Pour over chicken. 4 Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
